description.zh: 6周的根基性学习，涵盖基督教的核心信仰。
description.en: A 6-week foundational study covering the core beliefs of Christianity.

description.zh: 走过福音书，发现基督的生活和教导。
description.en: Walk through the Gospels and discover the life and teachings of Christ.

description.zh: 学习祷告的大能，如何在属灵争战中站立得稳。
description.en: Learn the power of prayer and how to stand firm in spiritual warfare.

description.zh: 为完成大使命、分享福音预备你的心。
description.en: Prepare your heart to fulfill the Great Commission and share the Gospel.
